quest.title: Gourmet Supremos: Within Our Duties
quest.description: You bump into a group of familiar faces in Sumeru...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ah, so this is Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: What are you sniffing?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Didn't you say Sumeru has a lot of spices? I don't smell any of them!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Spices are sealed in the warehouses. How can we even smell them at the harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Whoa... That's a huge one... Is that the Divine Tree that holds the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Does it bear any fruit? Hmm... maybe... Divine Fruit?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: There's no such fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: If researchers feel hungry when reading, they could pick some of these fruits to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: We have canteens...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Hehe, everyone, there's no point staying at the port.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Doesn't Ms. Parvaneh have some business at the Akademiya? We should head off now. Can't afford to waste time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, I didn't expect to meet you here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's been a while. Are you here to look for ingredients for some tasty food?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Sort of... But before we start to look for any, we need to run some errands with Parvaneh.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Actually, it's my paper on "Omni-Spice." I've finished it and am about to report to the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But you guys don't have to come with me! I'll catch up with you after this is over.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: A bunch of people just flooding into the Akademiya... They would've thought I was hijacked!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Are you feeling embarrassed now?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Huh!? Why would I feel embarrassed!?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: There's nothing fun in the Akademiya. All you can do is wait for me there...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: That's all right. I've always wanted to go to the Akademiya, but I've only heard about it from people in the guild...

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Ms. Parvaneh, Mr. Xudong was just worried that you could run into something sticky.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: After all, you have been away for too long. No one knows what would happen on your return.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Mr. Kamei gets me!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: What are you even talking about? My tutor is too nice to make things difficult for me.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I've been in contact with her. She's read my draft.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I'll just have to submit the finalized version this time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That'd be great. You could just take us as tourists.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Going to the Akademiya for a tour... Seriously?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Come if you want. I should be able to get it over with in no time.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: And after this...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I'll take you for tasty food... Don't worry I won't forget.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Traveler, you should come with us. You offered us so much help, now it's my turn to treat you in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Then let's get going. It should take a while to get to the Akademiya from here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That sounds weird!

choices.text: I'm here for the free meals!

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Wow, such a huge tree!

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Watch your step when you walk. Don't fixate on that tree, Ms. Julie.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Ah! I smell it! The aroma of delicacies!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Just go and play somewhere, and I'll catch up with you in a minute...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: No way. We must make sure everyone enjoys the savory meals. No one should be left out.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: You are unbelievable... Fine, the Akademiya is up there. Let's get going.

talks.objective: Go to the Akademiya with Parvaneh and the rest of the group

dialogues.speaker: Farzah
dialogues.text: Haha, Parvaneh, you are back. I've been waiting for so long.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Sorry I'm late, Ms. Farzah. Something happened on the way and it took me a while.

dialogues.speaker: Farzah
dialogues.text: No worries! Your paper is well-written, and your research looks very promising, too! I've heard a lot of good words about it.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Thank you. I brought the whole paper with me...

dialogues.speaker: Farzah
dialogues.text: Well... great work, Parvaneh.

dialogues.speaker: Farzah
dialogues.text: I'll take a good look at it later. With your academic ability, I'm sure there won't be any issue.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Y—You are too kind, Ms. Farzah...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Did Parvaneh just blush? You don't see that every day.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: It is really something to be proud of to be recognized by your mentor.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Hmm... What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I don't like that mentor of hers...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: And why is that, Ms. Julie?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Don't know. It's just a feeling...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm too exhausted. Don't tell Parvaneh. I don't wanna upset her.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: What are you guys talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Urgh... It's nothing! I—I'm starving...!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Haven't you eaten already? You really have a voracious appetite, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Ms. Julie is not a sedentary person. Of course she gets hungry fast.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Parvaneh, have you gotten it over with your business?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Almost. I'll just have to wait for the paper to be formally reviewed, which should be completed in the next few days.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: After this... Hmph, I can work on the projects that I like.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: The "Omni-Spice" has not been refined. I shall perfect it when I have a whole team!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I still have things to do before my paper gets approved. You better stay at Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I can't afford more time to look for you...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: No worries. The whole city is enough for a tour.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Now that you're done here, how about you show us around?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: And.. some Sumeru local specialties maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Finally, huh? I can see that look on your face...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Let me see... Let's go to the headquarters of the Corps of Thirty.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Eh? Thirty people? That can't be all they have.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: It's just a name, don't worry... Anyway, let's go and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Julie, why are you silent? Something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Huh? No, no. I—I'm just hungry! I'll be fine with some food.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: How do you even manage to stay in shape with that appetite...

talks.objective: Go to the headquarters of the Corps of Thirty

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: This is the place!

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Stationed here is the Corps of Thirty, responsible for the defense of Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: The name came from its founders. There were exactly thirty of them.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: The entire Corps has expanded, but the name remains in memory of the founders.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Like The Four Winds in Mondstadt. Pretty easy to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: It's just like the Liyue Qixing in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Eh? Why are you all looking at me?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Hmm... We have the Tri-Commission in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regions have their names in a similar way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It appears so, but it's more than thirty people when we talk about the Corps of Thirty in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: That guard there looks like a Martial Artist. He looks really worried.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you getting excited? It's not a commission!

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: Ah, you must've come to Sumeru City for a visit.

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: I'm Yunus, a logistics officer of the Corps of Thirty in the Citadel of Regzar.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You look worried... Ran into some trouble?

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: Yes. Monsters in the wild have been restless for reasons unknown. We've had to send someone out to drive them away.

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: They move so fast in large numbers. People we sent to deal with them got whacked every time.

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: I was wondering what meals our cook should prepare for them.

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: Ah, it seems that another bunch of our men should be back now...

response.speaker: Yunus
response.text: Now, if you'll excuse me. Have a good time in Sumeru City.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: What a man of action...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Whew... I'm glad he didn't talk to me. I'm afraid of dealing with people from the Eremites...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Let me see... We'll head to Adventurers' Guild next.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Though I don't think it would be any different from the guilds of anywhere else...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: But Julie may want to see it.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Ugh... Julie?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Huh? What was that?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: We are going to visit the Adventurers' Guild. Are you coming?

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Yeah! I've always wanted to visit there. L—Let's roll!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Chill out! It's no serious business.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Is this the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. Anything you're here for?

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: If you're looking to take commissions, just ask Katheryne over there.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: You seem dispirited, Julie. Are you feeling exhausted?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'm a little tired.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: We hardly got any rest after getting off the ship, and I'm exhausted too.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: We should get something to eat soon and turn in, Parvaneh.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: That sounds good. Shevirme's grill should still be open, so we ought to feast there.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Let's roll. I didn't expect Sumeru City to be so big that it wore me out just window shopping!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Finally, local Sumeru delicacies! Can't wait!

talks.objective: Taste the local specialties in Sumeru

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: Parvaneh? You're back?

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: Are those your friends behind you?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Yes, they just got to Sumeru and I've been showing them around the city.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I saw you're open and wanted to get some Shawarma Wraps. Got enough ingredients for us?

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? Of course I do! Six rolls, one for each person, right? Give me a few minutes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Paimon can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Shevirme starts to cook...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: The smell, the taste... It's heavenly!

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: What an amazing flavor, completely different from Inazuma's cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: How is it, Julie?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Delicious, thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Why are you so polite all of a sudden? Are you feeling okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what's next?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We reserved lodging and will check in soon.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We'll leave Sumeru after Parvaneh's thesis gets officially passed.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: After her thesis is accepted, she has to stay with the Akademiya to do research work, so she can't come with us anymore.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: It's what she wants. She talked to us about it and we all understand.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That might be true, but it will feel like we're missing something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's why Julie's seemed distracted the whole way...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That's probably the cause.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Even though everyone tried to avoid the subject, Parvaneh will likely remain with the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Come on, this is not the end of the world. It's not like we'll never see her again!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We can even bum a meal off the Akademiya when we come back later.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh told us before that she kept in touch with her mentor, so she should get the result for her thesis in two or three days.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Yeah, come back to the Akademiya tomorrow and hang out with us.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Since we have no idea when the next time will be after we leave Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Shameless. She doesn't deserve the title of a researcher!

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Plagiarizing and deceiving... That's what she learned at the Akademiya!?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: How can Ms. Parvaneh get scolded by such scum!?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Chill, Mr. Kamei. This is the Akademiya. The Corps of Thirty is right down there.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Try anything rash and we'll all get busted!

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Hmph... If we were back in Inazuma, I'd let my blade do the talking!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is everyone so angry? What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Traveler, you couldn't have come at... a worse time...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: She's over there. I'll brief you on what happened.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Last night we went back to the inn with Parvaneh for a little chat.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh was suddenly called away by a man from the Akademiya, who said something went wrong with her paper and she needed to discuss it with her mentor.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: She was supposed to go alone. But we were a bit worried, so we went with her.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We heard outside that the researcher Farzah was talking to Parvaneh...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: They started arguing, then Parvaneh came out, slammed the door, and bumped into us.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: She explained to us that her paper might have been plagiarized by Farzah to... make some deals with someone.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We talked all night and couldn't come up with any good ideas, so today we came with her to talk to Farzah again.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Since Mr. Kamei got really angry, we're staying here, while Julie has gone with Parvaneh.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I could feel the tension in the air. Don't know how things are going over there...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I'll never cooperate with you. I've told you that!

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Miss Parvaneh, I sincerely advise you to reconsider. This kind of win-win business is hard to come by.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Win-win? I'm not trying to win. I didn't write this paper to make money!

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Hmph... This is not what we agreed on, Miss Farzah.

response.speaker: Farzah
response.text: I'm not gonna lie to you. You can get your research out to the public faster by working with Mr. Nète.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Sounds like a liar...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Stay away from Parvaneh.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Or I won't be so polite.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Hmph... Miss Farzah, I presume something's wrong with the security of the Akademiya? Since when could an Adventurer come in here and give us cheek?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Julie, it's okay.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Ms. Farzah, I'll never trade "Omni-Spice" for even one Mora.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Since I wrote the first word of this paper, I've told you I'll provide the research results to anyone in need for free.

response.speaker: Farzah
response.text: *sigh* Why won't you just listen...

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: See, I knew it would come to this.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: That's all right, Miss Parvaneh. You can rest assured I won't make it difficult for you.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Even if you don't want to work with me... We'll find another way.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Farzah and Nète take their leave...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Parvaneh, are you alright?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: This is bad...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Those two... They must've been planning this for a while.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: My mentor... No, Farzah's had her eyes on my spice from the start. No wonder she was always so eager to discuss my paper with me...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Now she's developed a whole new project based on my paper, and made another seasoning to sell.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: It's practically impossible for us to stop her from making an advanced "Omni-Spice"...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Looks like there's no other choice. We can only go with my dumb idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You already have an idea?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Of course not. It took us a whole night to figure it out.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Yes, I'm a chef... But I started out as a restaurant owner in Liyue Harbor, and I know a trick or two about running a business.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh briefed me with some details, and I think I know how Farzah will make money off "Omni-Spice."

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Those two misers will have to keep the spice formula to themselves if they want to make any money.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: And my stupid way is the exact opposite of their plan, and that's...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: To give the formula away to the public for free first.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If everyone had the formula for free, few would buy it when Nète tries to sell it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how do we give it to the people out there?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hehe, guess what the Gourmet Supremos do best? We make meals with all ingredients and spices...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you saying you're going to spread the formula by making dishes with it?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: It's okay...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: It's just some dumb paper. No worries.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I had intended to give the "Omni-Spice" formula to everyone for free with my resources at the Akademiya anyway.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Nothing wrong with giving the formula away in the most straightforward way.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Parvaneh...

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Ms. Parvaneh...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh is indeed a true researcher at the Sumeru Akademiya. What an answer.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Then let's do what we planned last night!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Nète might have drummed up many to help him sell the formula. We must get ahead of him!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Julie, please ask the Adventurers' Guild for a list of villages that demand a lot of hard labor: fishing, lumbering or hunting. As long as it takes toil!

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Leave it to me!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Mr. Kamei, please help us collect spices we are gonna need for cooking dishes.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: I'll take care of that. Ms. Parvaneh has told me where to find Harra Fruit.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I know I can rely on you. Traveler, could you help Mr. Kamei find Harra Fruit for us?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: We'll leave it in your hands, then.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh and I will go back to the inn and figure out the menu. And when you're ready, we'll meet here.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, let me show you the rendezvous.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Let's roll. I didn't expect to have such fun in Sumeru City. This trip really is worth my time!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: No problem. I'll leave the most savory one for you!

choices.text: Is there any way we can stop her?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Harra Fruit should be over there.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Let's split up and end this quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I just noticed there are traces of monsters around.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: We could run into monsters if we keep going. Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Please rendezvous with me once you have the Harra Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I'll be counting on you then.

talks.objective: Defeat all monsters to get materials

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Sorry, I haven't found any Harra Fruit... Anything on your end?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Great. These should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I need to gather some other ingredients nearby. Traveler, please go back and check on Ms. Julie.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: Physical labor? If I must, I'll say Vimara Village, Caravan Ribat, and Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: Vimara has farmers. Caravan Ribat and Port Ormos have a lot of menial laborers too.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: But why do you want to know? Got a job to offer?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: A good friend of mine asked me to look into this.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: I see. Let me mark the locations on the map for you. They're all quite a way from the city, so try not to get lost.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Thanks to this mister's help, we got the locations.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: The rendezvous is not far from here, Traveler. Let's hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Thank you, Mr. Kamei, the ingredients should be enough. Parvaneh and I have decided on the menu.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We'll only need to wait for Julie to tell us where to make the meals.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Great. Did you get any information?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: We'd better go to Vimara Village and Caravan Ribat. They are marked on the map.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Sweet! We've got no time to waste. Let's visit Vimara Village first.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Field trip again...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Parvaneh? Why are you here? Didn't you go back to the Akademiya to submit your paper?

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: And why are there a bunch of people behind you? What is all this!?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Well, it's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Parvaneh tells Nabati what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Food for marketing. That's new.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: But how could Farzah do this? It doesn't make sense. There's no news of her project being suspended, and she is getting paid as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Why are we doing business with a Fontaine guy...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Anyway, this is the situation. Come and help me! Think about the tons of homework you copied from me!

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: I didn't copy you! Don't forget, you referenced my outline!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Old acquaintances we've got here...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Hi there, I'm Nabati. I do research on the human body at Amurta.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Though my project hasn't been approved...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: We went to the Akademiya together long ago, but we didn't really work together since we were studying different subjects.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Thank god we didn't. I could've choked on your weird dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Don't stare at me like that. Let's get down to business.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: You want to make dishes that appeal to the local taste in Vimara Village, right?

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Vimara is located in a very convenient spot. It's a key area along the waterway to Sumeru. And if you go along the waterway, you will get to Port Ormos.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: And most ships dock at Port Ormos.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Hard labors like loading cargo and repair work are mostly done at Port Ormos.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Over time, many people went to work there. Now only elders and kids stay at the village.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: And slackers like me, of course.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Do you know what kind of food the folks like here?

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Hmm... Light meals I guess. And fish is a regular dish here.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: This place is so far away from the city that seasonings are hard to buy. Sometimes the dishes are incredibly bland.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: The elders couldn't tell the difference, but I just couldn't stand it...

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: A peculiar guy from Fontaine did try to sell the spice you mentioned, but the residents here simply couldn't afford it...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hehe, then it'd be great for you to try Parvaneh's "Omni-Spice."

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Let's get back to business. Mr. Kamei, Julie, please help me set up the pot.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Mr. Nabati, I'm now introducing to you, the amazing "Omni-Spice."

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Any dish with this "Omni-Spice" will have a delicious taste.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If you don't believe me, you can try the "Fish With Cream Sauce" made with this "Omni-Spice."

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, please help us find some fresh fish and drop it off to Parvaneh. I'll have to go through the recipe a few more times...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Just checked this recipe five times. Whew... Hopefully we can make it right...

choices.text: They don't seem to have any hard labors to do...

talks.objective: Give the three servings of Fresh Fish to Parvaneh

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I must be crazy to actually do this... Ah! Traveler, did you get the ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Everything is ready... I've just checked the recipe twice more. Seven times in total. There won't be any problems.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: If there's a problem, I'll find a way out.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Alright, show's on!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Xudong starts cooking...

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: This is delicious! And it doesn't seem to have any special spices...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That's what makes the "Omni-Spice" so special! It brings out the flavor in the food, giving it an amazing taste.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: More importantly, "Omni-Spice" is not difficult to make.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: How much is this "Omni-Spice"? I'd like to buy some to try.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I'll give you the formula. Since you are a researcher, I'm sure you can make one on your own.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Wait, you're just giving it to me like that? This could sell for a lot of Mora! That Fontaine peddler put a high price on the spice.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: And you're not happy about it? Take it, and be sure to share it with others. Don't just use it for your own food.

response.speaker: Nabati
response.text: Okay. Parvaneh, you are crazy...

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I think I am too. But it's good to be crazy once in a while.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Anyways, the formula is in your hands. Remember to share!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Since we can head to Port Ormos via the waterway, let's go there next.

choices.text: You sure everything will be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: We're back to Port Ormos again.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: So many people here. Where do we even start?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: How about I beat someone in a duel and then recommend the spice to them?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Why do you have to beat someone in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Eh? Where did Xudong go?

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: Whoa...! So many port stevedores in Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Yeah. We got whacked every time we finish unloading.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since when did he start chitchatting with that guy...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One of Xudong's talents I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Life's so hard. Especially when you have to cook for yourself after getting off work. I feel exhausted just thinking about it.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Not for me. I have a special spice that can easily help me make delicious meals.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well that was abrupt!

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: What... Are you here to peddle goods like the Fontaine guy? I don't have time for this.

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: I'd rather you just give me an offer like that Fontaine vendor did. And just to be clear, I don't have much in my pocket to handle some fancy spice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh! Busted!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Wait, our spice is nothing like what the Fontaine guy was selling to you.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: We'll make a dish with the spice for you to try. For free.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That way you'll see how good this spice is.

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: This is too good to be true...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Chefs are generous. Traveler, please help us find two Potatoes and drop them off to Parvaneh.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me think about making a "Potato Boat" for this mister.

talks.objective: Give the two Potatoes to Parvaneh

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Here he goes again... Traveler, did you get the ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That should do. Let me heat the pot up...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Xudong starts cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: Finished already? Where's the spicing?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Like I said, with this "Omni-Spice," any dish can become a delicious one.

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: This must cost a pile of Mora. The Fontaine peddler put a high price on his spice, too...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Here, this is the formula of "Omni-Spice." It's easy to prepare. You can make some back at home.

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you mean? You don't want my Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: We want nothing from you. Instead, we kindly ask you to share this formula to the public.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Well, you got it for free. It'd be nice to give it to others as a free favor, wouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: That makes sense... Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xudong's got quite a way with words. Paimon didn't see that before...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That's one of the skills a chef must master. You can't take care of customers of all kinds without a silver tongue, can you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's so hard to be a chef at Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Okay. Our final stop would be "Caravan Ribat."

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Parvaneh said she knows Maryam, owner of Gilded Journey. And she told her about our spice marketing.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Let's hope it goes well this time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: You're finally back. I thought you'd give up halfway through.

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: I heard it from Parvaneh. You tried to give the spice away for free in response to that Fontaine guy?

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: What a stupid idea for an Akademiya researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Sorry, the idea came from me. I'm a chef.

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: Hmm... Since I know Parvaneh, I can help you promote this "Omni-Spice."

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: You must have been tired after all the work.

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: Hey chef, the ingredients are all ready in the kitchen, and there's a fire and a pot outside. You can cook something anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: And take a good rest when you're done. The lady researcher must be tired even if you are not.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I dare not refuse it.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you please help me gather some Padisarahs? It's certainly been a long day for everyone, and I wanna prepare a fine meal to treat everybody.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: I'll prepare the rest of the ingredients. When you get the Padisarahs, please give them to Parvaneh. Thank you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: No worries. It was way more exhausting back when I was making banquets back in Liyue.

talks.objective: Give the three Padisarahs to Parvaneh

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: It's great Miss Maryam is willing to help... Traveler, did you get the Padisarahs?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That should be enough. I'll take care of it. It won't be long.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Xudong starts cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Ah, that smells good! What did you make?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: This is "Tandoori Roast Chicken." It sounds weird, but does have a good taste.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: When did you learn to cook this? I've never seen you do that before.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Flicked through the recipe yesterday. It's in my mind now.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: You are such an exceptional chef, Mr. Xudong...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: I might have been able to speed up my research if I'd known you sooner...

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: That Nète guy... seems to be exactly where we're going, and he's always one step ahead of us.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: He didn't seem to be able to sell any spice... But why has he been keeping pace with us?

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: I don't have a good feeling about that Nète guy...

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: I guess you're well rested. Take this letter. That Nète guy from Fontaine asked me to give it to you.

response.speaker: Maryam
response.text: The guy's left. He paid me to prepare the ingredients and wait for you to come.

response.speaker: Maryam
response.text: He told me to give you the letter after you have rested.

response.speaker: Maryam
response.text: Sorry for not telling you this. But he paid a lot.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Parvaneh, what does it say?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: ...Bunch of sentimental crap. He said he has business to talk about with us at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Hmph, I guess that scum's had enough and is appealing to arms?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: It would actually be better if that was the case...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, if Nète said so. We're so going there for a meet-up.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, could you come with us for another trip?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hehe, I'll be looking forward to it, then.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Then let's get going. Time to see what this guy wants.

choices.text: When did he give it to you?

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: Welcome! Welcome, everyone. I've been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: What are you up to? Stay away!

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: Easy, Miss Adventurer. I don't wish to fight you, nor do I have the ability to.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: Your plan has worked. Your free spice is taking over the market. It'll be even harder for me to promote a new spice.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: You've won this one. Please go easy on this poor businessman.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: You're lying through your teeth... I have never met a man more loathsome than you.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: Hahaha! It seems like you haven't dealt with many businessmen, then.

dialogues.speaker: Parvaneh
dialogues.text: You are not with Farzah?

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: She might be working on her new formula. Locked herself in her room and won't come out... But to be honest, I don't really care about this.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: You know, I did tons of work just to skirt around some boring clauses... And she wouldn't even get down from her high horse as a researcher. I also had to find resources to promote her spice because she refused to do it herself.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: I was wrong. She's not the right pick for a business partner.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: But now I think you're perfect for business.

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: You have plans and are willing to get your hands dirty. Plus, you have pretty decent skills.

choices.text: Are you here to cause trouble?

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Relax, I just want to ask... Are there any opportunities for me to invest in you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: Do you know what you're talking about?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: You are so unpredictable.

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: Hmph. Liar.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Are you serious?

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Of course I am. What makes you think I'm not?

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Your spice formula is taking root on the market, enjoying popularity and reputation among consumers.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: The formula Ms. Farzah is making will be of higher quality, but it's somewhat difficult to promote.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: And I know you are not willing to cooperate with her.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: So here's my offer: I'll invest in your spice and organize resources for the business.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Part of the profits I made from Ms. Farzah's formula will be used to promote your formula for free, and the rest of the profits... will be all yours.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: You don't have to pay a single Mora. You just need to put my "trademark" on the back of your formula.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: What do you say?

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: I say no. I've told you before. I don't want anything to do with you.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: And why would you even want to invest in our formula? Ms. Farzah is a more experienced researcher who has way more resources than me.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Experiences, resources... Those can be improved in many ways.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: But you cannot build your word of mouth like that overnight, hehe...

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: Huh, I think I've said too much. Well, I guess that's it for today. I have to go back and see if Ms. Farzah is starving in her lab.

response.speaker: Nète
response.text: I will stay in Sumeru for some time. I sincerely look forward to working with you one day. So long.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Nète leaves...

response.speaker: Julie
response.text: I'm so sick of him...

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: He could be more tricky than monsters...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Farzah, Nète... I guess the whole thing is not as simple as we had hoped for.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Looks like we won't be able to leave Sumeru for now. We must look into this.

response.speaker: Parvaneh
response.text: *sigh* I just wanted to do my research. Why did I get into this mess...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Haha, it is what it is. A restaurant must be cleaned before it can be opened to customers.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Don't worry. We'll get to the bottom of this.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Traveler, looks like we're gonna team up again. We might still need your help in the future.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That's the spirit!

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But... What is this Nète plotting...?

choices.text: As long as there's free meals.
What are you trying to do?

dialogues.speaker: Nète
dialogues.text: You really have no business sense. Good thing you've met me...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I didn't expect all this to happen in Sumeru. This is fun...

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Parvaneh, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: It's pretty tranquil here.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Omni-Spice? What's that supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: That Fontaine guy's name must be Nète.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Why is Xudong chatting with everyone...?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I feel humbled before one with such affinity...

dialogues.speaker: Neriman
dialogues.text: How come a man sells spice like this?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Wow, that looks like a nice pot.

dialogues.speaker: Julie
dialogues.text: Wow, she looks like such a proper lady...

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: A mysterious lady...

dialogues.speaker: Maryam
dialogues.text: Why don't you rest up over here?
